title: App experience: 13-composition vertical rhythm fixed (52→80px gaps)
summary: All 12 inter-frame gaps on the Tenure / App experience page were 52px instead of the canonical 80px; top padding was 40px instead of 80px; rt-stamp tail was unanchored at 18px. Recomputed Y positions for all 13 compositions using y = 80 + (i × 1162), set rt-stamp at Spacing/2xl (32px) below the final frame with matching 32px section tail, and resized the section to 15192px. Every gap now reads 80px, confirmed by re-read audit and full-section screenshot.
accessibility: No contrast pairs touched. No colour changes. O-1 status unchanged.
